nLevel.text: D. The level-up snackbar today says only the number. Now it says what grew, with a small picture and a button to see it. Rank-ups (5, 10, 15, 20, 35, 50, 75, 100) open the new chapter instead.

nPage.text: B. The proud view. The island big; tap a thing to see when it grew. Under it: your level plate and what the next base brings, your collection (you choose which six stand out), and the dates ripening from medals.

nProfile.text: A. The door. A card under the stats row: the world, the level bar Profile already has, and what the next level brings. The hero above stays exactly as it is. A thirsty day shows here with one plain line about the world, never about the person.

nReveal.text: E. People already on level 12 open the update to a world that is already grown: everything they earned, planted at once. One screen, one button, shown once.

nStart.text: Press Play. Tap any + and pick what Doum plants there; tap a planted thing to change it. Three tabs: things that grow with your level, things you build with gold, and rare showpieces that open with each base. Slide the level and watch the base change: sand, stone, coral, gold, rainbow, pearl ring, star crown. The art is from your seven sheets.

nThirsty.text: C. The loop. Two quiet days: ledge Doum holds his can and asks once, with a tiny picture of the thirsty world in his bubble. Tap any square: he waters, the picture freshens, the bubble says it drank. Then he goes back to his day pose.

nTry.text:
How to try. Open a phone full-window: it works like the app, and its buttons move between phones.

Start at «A. Profile» (row above): tap the island card, then «امشِ فيها», «رتّب» or «جيرانك».

1. Neighbours: tap Khalid's island. Water, gift, like, then «انزل وتمشّى في واحته».
2. Walk: tap the ground; Doum turns and walks with real steps. Palm: «قطّف رطبة». Jasmine: «خذ عقلة». Bench: «اجلس». Lantern arch: «شغّل الأنوار». House: «ادخل». «هدية»: he carries a basket over. Camera, top left: a photo.
3. Inside: tap any piece to swap it. «اجلس» seats him on the cushions. «ليل» lights the lanterns.
4. Edit: pick something in the tray, tap a +. Tap a thing: move, flip, make it gold. Switch designs at the top.
5. Play: your own island; tap the palm, the lemon, the house.
6. Builder: three tabs and the level slider.

nWidget.text: F. Decision 6. The world on the Home Screen, without Doum (rule 7). It changes with the day: thirsty after quiet days, fresh after the first habit, asleep at night. The calmest reminder there is, and it never makes a sound.

nSimple.text:
How to try. Open «1. Your oasis» full-window: it works like the app, and «رتّب» and «أصحابك» move to the other two.

Wait two seconds: Doum walks to the bench, hops up and sits. Tap the palm, a plant, the bench.

The dashed strip under that phone is for testing only: «مستوى جديد» plants the next thing, «ليالي رمضان» shows the season.

In «رتّب»: tap a thing you have, then «نسخة ذهبية من هذا».

In «أصحابك»: «شغّلها», Yousef, the sidr, «خذ شتلة».

Everything below this row is the earlier, deeper version.
